name: Melting Wilds
description: Widespread melting of the Qal Sisma's icy reaches that accompanied Atarka's arrival.

timeline.summary: Atarka arrives with her brood's storms, causing the Melting Wilds, and conquers Qadat.
timeline.quote: the arrival of Atarka and the storms that birthed her brood were accompanied by widespread melting of the icy reaches in the Qal Sisma Mountains
